title: A novel machine learning algorithm selects proteome signature to specifically identify cancer exosomes
summary: RF selection of an exosome protein signature from published proteomic datasets and evaluation across cancer/normal datasets; linked bioRxiv preprint carries the same result. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
